title: SB187 (2024 Regular): AN ACT relating to modified weapons.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Kentucky); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Kentucky text (Introduced, 0000-00-00; official copy, https://apps.legislature.ky.gov/recorddocuments/bill/24RS/sb187/orig_bill.pdf (LegiScan doc 2921068))
provenance.note: As-filed (BR 1586, 2/8/2024); no passage vote in the record. Section 1 (1) defines 'modified weapon' in detail (semiautomatic rifles, shotguns and pistols with listed features); not quoted for length.

operative_text:
Section 1 (new section of KRS Chapter 237): (2) A licensed dealer as defined in KRS 527.090 may not deliver a modified weapon to a purchaser until seven (7) days have elapsed from the date of the purchase application.
Section 2 (new section of KRS Chapter 527): (1) A person is guilty of possession of a modified weapon when, being under the age of twenty-one (21) years, he or she possesses, manufactures, or transports a modified weapon as defined in Section 1 of this Act, except when the person is: (a) A member of the Armed Forces of the United States or the Kentucky National Guard; or (b) A law enforcement officer as defined in KRS 15.310.
Section 2 (new section of KRS Chapter 527): (2) Possession of a modified weapon by a person under twenty-one (21) years of age is a Class A misdemeanor for the first offense and a Class D felony for a second or subsequent offense.
Section 3 (new section of KRS Chapter 527): (1) No person shall knowingly sell or transfer a modified weapon as defined in Section 1 of this Act to any person under twenty-one (21) years of age.
Section 3 (new section of KRS Chapter 527): (2) Any person who violates the provisions of subsection (1) of this section is guilty of a Class D felony for the first offense and a Class C felony for a second or subsequent offense.
